scope: Shared Lab candidate design only; no fixes or implementation

findings.title: Publication evidence is not bound to the complete reviewed publication
findings.problem: SemanticCoverage checks each review against itself but never requires review.source_cut to equal PublicationCase.source_cut. A set of self-consistent reviews from another cut reaches PublicationPlanReady. The alreadyPublished branch preserves an opaque receipt and postimage before checking permission or native receipt. PublicationCase has no separate canonical-publication authorization, full bundle binding, expected native HEAD, or typed publication-receipt verification. The prose explicitly requires these facts but the executable contract does not represent them. Merely naming a future trusted verifier does not define the exact proposition it must attest.
missing_or_incomplete_contracts: VerifiedObservation binding subject, predicates, scope, source cut, issuer/role, verification policy and receipt
PublicationBundle and exact canonical-publication authorization
ObservedPublicationReceipt bound to original operation, bundle, predecessor and selected postimage
findings.required_design_correction: Specify typed, independently verified observations and require all review cuts to match the publication cut. Bind proposed registry/index/source postimages and target digest to the reviewed bundle and scoped authorization. Recovery may preserve an actual historical receipt without demanding a fresh permission, but only after verifying its exact historical operation and postimage; an arbitrary nonempty Binding is insufficient.
findings.owner: shared Lab design; not Define implementation

findings.title: Compatibility does not establish exact retained reads or upgrade authority
findings.problem: UpgradeReviewBound checks target, predecessor, outcome and presence of evidence, but CompatibilityCase has no expected owner, scope or review cut to compare. A different owner/scope/cut reaches CandidateSuccessor. ReadRetained can select different source/target bodies and still return HistoricalRead. allowed_target_relations is caller supplied rather than bound to the selected schema; relation mappings are kind pairs, not an edge-by-edge complete source/target mapping. Schema/generator and normative-digest provenance remain opaque.
missing_or_incomplete_contracts: CompatibilityAssessment with exact source/target identities and representation contracts
Scoped owner review and complete relation-mapping evidence
Normative selection/digest algorithm and fidelity manifest
findings.required_design_correction: Require exact unchanged body for a retained read. Require actual expected owner/role, scope and cut for upgrades. Derive supported relation kinds from the selected verified schema, bind every transformed relation edge and original generator, and define canonical normative-digest selection without dropping relation semantics. Explicitly reviewed meaning change stays distinct from representation-only upgrade.
findings.owner: shared Lab design; not Define implementation

findings.title: Lifecycle acceptance does not authorize the exact lifecycle transition
findings.problem: LifecycleOwnerMatches binds only the current body and source cut, not the requested intent or successor, expected owner/scope, impact closure, permission proposal or native operation. An owner review accepted for current bytes in a withdrawal fixture also permits a revision to an arbitrary successor. Closure and permission are presence-only bindings. Existing prose asks for complete consumer coverage but has no typed coverage attestation.
missing_or_incomplete_contracts: LifecycleTransitionProposal binding intent, predecessor, successor and exact effects
Owner/permission binding to that proposal
ImpactClosure attestation with declared consumer universe, cursors, limits and unresolved observations
findings.required_design_correction: Bind review and permission to one exact transition. Require current and successor identity/bytes, actual scope/owner and complete source-bound impact manifest. Specify empty universe, unregistered consumers, cycle handling, truncated traversal and stale-cut behavior. No successor-of edge implicitly withdraws its predecessor.

findings.title: Join continuation and transitions do not form a complete recoverable protocol
findings.problem: JoinContinuation ignores phase: a Completed join with native and publication Committed returns PublicationPlanReady. The state machine cannot resolve NativeUnknown to a proven Refused outcome; PublicationUnknown similarly lacks refusal handling. Signals are bare enums rather than exact verified observations, and no contract joins persisted phase/revision, immutable evidence, source transition and original operation. An enum signal alone can propose semantic acceptance or permission without evidence.
missing_or_incomplete_contracts: JoinContinuation decision table including all phases/outcomes and terminal behavior
Guarded transition command with phase/revision CAS and exact observation evidence
Typed observation/event journal and unknown-outcome reconciliation protocol
findings.required_design_correction: Design phase/outcome consistency and terminal idempotency first. Add all justified recovery/refusal paths without treating unknown as rollback. Bind each transition to verified evidence and a journal revision. Keep StateMachine as transition logic and define the workflow/transaction boundary that actually persists transitions; do not invent unsupported Workflow/Event syntax in the current profile.
findings.owner: shared Lab design; not Define implementation

findings.title: Construction evidence is represented by labels and decisions rather than bound specifications
findings.problem: Entry compares List<Ref> obligation labels against List<Ref> check labels; the passing fixture supplies no executable check specification. Completion accepts an entry_decision enum rather than a receipt tied to the actual seven-stage source selection. independent_assessment and independence_review are opaque, with no typed per-obligation results, assessor identity or exact input binding. Definition target lists need not prove completeness relative to the Definitions stage subject. The same-cut strings alone cannot establish these links.
missing_or_incomplete_contracts: ExecutableCheckSpecification and obligation-to-check coverage mapping
ConstructionEntryReceipt bound to seven subjects, six handoffs and exact definitions selection
IndependentConformanceAssessment bound to entry, outputs, assessor and per-check results
findings.required_design_correction: Model check executors, versioned specifications, fixtures/inputs, expected outcomes and check-policy bindings. Tie completion to a verified entry receipt and exact output manifest. Derive required checks from the selected obligations; do not let an input shrink the required universe. Preserve inherited DomainSpec/prototype compatibility and separate pre-generation specifications from post-generation results.
findings.owner: shared Lab design; not Define implementation

findings.title: Cross-store publication has no explicit boundary relative to Admission Transaction
findings.problem: The selected admitted Admission Transaction definition requires all declared targets and deterministic consequences to apply atomically or none to apply. The design correctly avoids claiming a distributed atomic transaction, but does not specify which effects belong to the native local transaction, which to canonical admission/publication, or whether LocalCommitted means draft persistence or an admitted semantic effect. A recoverable sequence must not silently weaken the existing all-or-nothing contract. The proposed immutable snapshot/current-pointer model also lacks a closed reader-adoption and expected-selector receipt contract.
missing_or_incomplete_contracts: Authority/effect partition and selected Decision Bundle consequences
Atomic admission/publication boundary and recoverable transport protocol
CurrentSourceSelection CAS and reader-adoption/compatibility contract
findings.required_design_correction: Explicitly partition draft/native transport from authority-changing admission. If canonical registry/index/source consequences are in one Admission Transaction, stage them before exposing admission and bind them to its atomic selection; otherwise require an explicit reviewed compatibility/contract successor. A local committed draft may await publication; a partially applied declared admission may not be called successful.
findings.owner: shared Lab design; not Define implementation

findings.title: Ordered continuation choices are hidden inside Calculations
findings.problem: ChooseReviewOutcome selects Accepted/Rejected/needs-review business outcomes through nested matches; ChooseNativeOutcome selects inspect-original/publication-ready/needs-commit continuations. These are domain alternative-selection decisions under the behavioral-role criteria, not merely construction of a selected value. Compiler support for nested match expressions does not settle the semantic role.
missing_or_incomplete_contracts: Explicit review-outcome and native-outcome decision policies with ordered coverage
findings.required_design_correction: Move alternative selection into Policies (or fold it into the existing ordered Policies); keep Calculations as pure result constructors/derivations. ChooseDecision is a valid pure constructor. ToCreationPlan can remain a Mapping for deterministic shape/entry-reference translation, provided all eligibility/continuation choice remains in the named Policies.

findings.title: Join identity and replay uniqueness are underspecified
findings.problem: JoinRun designates caller-supplied UInt64 id as identity, while run_ref and operation_ref are not uniquely constrained or deterministically mapped. After an unknown initialization outcome, a new numeric id can represent the same run/operation twice. The Query includes source_cut in its filter, which may hide an existing historical run during recovery unless the original cut is retained. No explicit journal revision/apply or read-for-reconciliation contract is provided.
missing_or_incomplete_contracts: Join identity/uniqueness and immutable run-to-operation binding
Idempotent initialization/replay key and revision CAS
Historical recovery query distinct from current-scope eligibility
findings.required_design_correction: Specify stable run identity and original-operation correlation independent of a storage surrogate; require unique workspace/run and applicable operation tuple. Define original command replay and conflict semantics. Recovery must inspect original stored facts even if the current source selection changed.

findings.title: Typed ports and registry migration validators are still prose-only
findings.problem: FuturePortContracts is a valid bounded-schema data boundary, but it exposes DTOs rather than the seven promised port operations, errors and verified propositions. SYSTEM-MODEL names eight differently named ports including SourceTransitionResolver; no exact mapping closes them. Registry/v2 has a structural schema but uniqueness, preservation of old entries, current lookup, carrier/schema/generator consistency, projection fidelity and admission receipt validation remain descriptions without specified typed validator results. These missing adapters were honestly marked unimplemented; this finding is incomplete contract design, not an unexpected absence of runtime code.
missing_or_incomplete_contracts: Per-port request/response/error contracts, trust roots and verification policy
Port-name/owner mapping including source transition
RegistryMigrationAssessment, deterministic projection/index contract and hostile fixtures
findings.required_design_correction: Define contract signatures and exact evidence/error tags before wiring anything. Require a migration assessment covering retained entries, exact additions/transitions, lookup and projection consistency. Reuse the located embedded Registry/v1 contract and already admitted Definition/v2 carrier; no new Definition/v2 carrier admission or implicit downgrade is needed.
findings.owner: shared Lab design; not Define implementation

findings.title: The definitions-to-generation trace and bounded-selection contract are incomplete
findings.problem: The business model is a subject/invariant list, the bridge maps six coarse groups to operation names, and every handoff repeats a generic coverage obligation. They do not trace each selected definition clause through artifacts, business relations, bridge mappings, system contracts, declarations and check evidence. The binding list contains 41 admitted plus three pending Definitions (44); the pending-target list adds the two construction candidates, making 46 unique in-scope targets, while ConstructionCase/ReviewsAccepted/SemanticCoverage accept at most 24 reviews. No complete-selection manifest/partition protocol explains which clauses are in scope or how bounded batches compose without omissions. Several relevant existing definitions are not selected or explicitly assessed for applicability.
missing_or_incomplete_contracts: Clause/obligation-level coverage and handoff acceptance contracts
Complete selected-definition manifest or qualified bounded partition/aggregation protocol
Applicability assessment for existing Evidence, Role Assignment, event-ledger and exact-publication definitions
findings.required_design_correction: Build clause-level mappings and actual positive/negative check coverage, preserving explicit unresolved rows. Reuse existing definitions before proposing global new terms. Define a complete manifest plus bounded verified subsets or a justified supported bound; never truncate 46 selections to 24 to pass. Evaluate the scope of the exact-publication invariant before importing private-release obligations into internal canonical publication.
